game.title: TEKKEN 7
game.blurb: Fighting game from Bandai Namco Entertainment, released 2015-03-18. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action, Sports, Fighting. Chapters follow the game modes named in the Steam achievements.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 389730)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Tekken_7
Fandom (tekken.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://tekken.fandom.com/wiki/Tekken_7
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 389730 returns an empty game name in its schema; the store list confirms it as "TEKKEN 7". StrategyWiki has "Tekken 7" at completion stage 0. Its Moves (about 224,000 characters) and Achievements and trophies pages are written, but Walkthrough and Gameplay are near-empty, and The Mishima Saga and Tekken Bowl pages are linked but not written, so it was not used. tekken.fandom.com answers the API under "Tekken 7" with about 211 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 1 of 42 Steam achievements is hidden: "Master Of Iron Fist" (8.8%), API name TK_ACH_44, the last in the list. In a fighting game it is unlikely to be a story beat, so it sits in the ranks and mastery chapter as a guess. No achievement names an added fighter.
